inputs.name: RAM FFS root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: Boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel and attempt association with a scan-visible WPA2/SAE transition BSS using a strict SAE/PMF-required station profile.
expected: The station accepts the compatible BSS, completes SAE with required PMF, and exchanges data.
observed: Firmware was loaded at 115200 baud, and kernel/root at 460800 baud. The RAM boot reached the shell; the kernel trace showed no configuration or setup-validation errors, and the earlier null config-done callback panic did not recur. Scanning found three matching BSS entries on 2.4 GHz channels 8, 3 and 11. Their scan data advertised WPA2-PSK plus SAE with CCMP and SAE-H2E. The strict SAE/PMF-required attempt entered ASSOCIATING, then the vendor reported disconnect reason 210 NO_AP_FOUND_W_COMPATIBLE_SECURITY; the supplicant moved to TEMP-DISABLED/SCANNING. No IPv4 address or data exchange followed.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.

The visible transition BSS entries distinguish this result from an empty scan. Reason 210 reports a security-compatibility rejection, but does not locate every internal vendor filter decision relative to SAE.
The scan advertisement does not prove successful WPA3 negotiation or PMF protection. No IPv4 address, data exchange or WPA3 association was observed.
WPA2-only authentication, DHCP, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
